name: After Images
author: TheGrizard
tagline: a generative synth: four layers, one button, endless pieces
description: After Images makes endless ambient pieces: four layers (GROUND, BODY, LIGHT, DUST), each a generative sequencer (Euclidean, Turing machine, Markov, Lorenz, bouncing balls, orbits, cellular automaton, wind chimes, phase, Brownian) driving one of ten sound engines in its own frequency band. Press REC for a new piece. Macros on every page, everything locked to the scale, white keys play the scale and black keys its chords, MIDI out over USB.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp by Leo Kuroshita.
